preserveOriginIdentity: trial identity or explicit not-applicable marker
exportContract.forceWaveformRule: A direct demoulding/ejection-force waveform may count only when its unit/conversion is source-defined in the Origin project/export and its 10 kHz basis is verified from project metadata or the exported time vector, not from the paper alone.
exportContract.publicRepositoryBoundary: Retain aggregate manifests/profiles only; do not commit exported raw tables or OPJU binaries unless repository policy is explicitly changed.

operatorChecklist: Work on Windows in a licensed/validated Origin or OriginPro installation; record product, version and build in originEnvironment.

Before opening each OPJU, compute SHA-256 with Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 and replace REQUIRED_VERIFIED_SHA256 with the verified source hash. If the earlier verified copy is unavailable, re-download that exact Version 2 publisher file and verify it before use.
Open each of the five named OPJU projects and set originOpened=true only after Origin/OriginPro opens it without repair/conversion warnings that could alter data.
In Project Explorer, count workbooks plus worksheet/matrix objects and record projectReconciliation before exporting.

For every data-bearing worksheet or matrix, record workbook, sheet, zero-based sheetIndex, objectType and trialIdentity. Use trialIdentity.status=not-applicable only when the source project genuinely has no trial identity for that object.

For each column, copy the source name, unit text/status, Origin designation and any Origin formula. Mark only source-defined raw sensor/process columns as direct-measured; formulas, integrated energy and other derived columns must be derived-formula and non-counting.
For direct force waveforms, verify the 10 kHz basis from Origin project metadata or the exported time vector. Do not use the companion paper alone as sampling proof.

If force is already in N, record whether the project stores native force or an explicit project-documented voltage-to-force conversion. If only voltage is present, keep the source unit and do not reconstruct force solely from paper sensitivity.
Export each data-bearing table without resampling/recalculation as UTF-8 CSV (or TSV when needed) with exactly one header row matching columns[].name.
Compute SHA-256 for every exported CSV/TSV and record rowCount, columnCount and acceptedNumericCount for each direct-measured column.

Set allFiveProjectsReconciled=true only when every data-bearing Origin worksheet/matrix across all five projects is exported and reconciled; reconciled-ready-for-counting also requires zero skipped data-bearing objects.

Run: python tools/validate_warwick_origin_export.py --manifest <completed-manifest.json> --exports-root <export-directory>. Keep raw OPJU/CSV/TSV files out of the public repository; commit only the completed aggregate manifest/profile unless repository policy is explicitly changed.
